SELECT a.agent_id AS agent_id, a.status AS status, a.max_concurrency AS max_concurrency, a.status_time AS status_time, COALESCE(l.load, 0) AS active_count FROM agent_status a LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT COUNT(1) AS load FROM session s WHERE s.tenant_code = a.tenant_code AND s.agent_id = a.agent_id AND s.status = 3 AND s.is_deleted = FALSE ) l ON TRUE WHERE a.tenant_code = #{tenantCode} AND a.status = 1 AND a.is_connected = TRUE AND a.is_deleted = FALSE
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM skill_group_member m WHERE m.tenant_code = a.tenant_code AND m.skill_group_id = #{skillGroupId} AND m.user_id = a.agent_id AND m.status = 1 AND m.is_deleted = FALSE )
ORDER BY active_count ASC, a.status_time ASC
